Hero_Desc_Sist:
A dragon who buys and sells whatever she can. An amethyst dragon.
It seems like she has some sort of lofty goal, but there aren't many who know about it since she keeps a tight lip about it.
Album_Sist1: Sist is both indispensable and the most vicious dragon to ever exist in dragon society. Sist satisfies the dragons' greed as a smuggler who peddles medicine.
Album_Sist2: Sist has an unusual motto: 'Strong denials = Strong affirmations.' This manifests in her idea that the stronger you assert your dragon identity, the less people will believe it. She adorns herself with outrageous things to bring attention it... which is some strange logic.
Album_Sist3: Sist is a dragon with twisted ethics who, once a week, roams the entire Elias Forest to buy, snatch, pick up, or steal goods that her fellow dragons might find tempting.
Album_Sist4: Sist's best customer is the Jade, the jadestone dragon. She pretended the grape candy she found discarded on the roadside to be some sort of cure-all, which Jade liked and has been buying it ever since.
Album_Sist5: I asked Sist if she had any interest like the other dragons, who gather gems closely related to themselves. Sist confessed she used to like amethysts in the past, but lost interest because they are fragile and not profitable.
Album_Sist6: Sist is a dragon without a roost. Since is constantly buying and selling goods, she doesn't really need one. She even scammed someone into buying the roost she originally lived in for three times its value.
Album_Sist7: Curious about why Sist was so obsessed with money, I decided to have a conversation with her. It turns out she doesn't really care about accumulating wealth. She just enjoys the act of doing business. Sist confessed that she felt her birthstone was worthless, but running a business made her feel special. That's why she became so fixated on it.
LoveHero_Sist:
Oh, boss...
I mean, Master.
Want to become one of my regulars?
Sounds good!
LoveHeroCancel_Sist:
Was our relationship
purely business?
The world truly is
cold.
Food_ChefNote_Sist_Hate1: Sist declined the deal, saying that the product I offered was unpopular and had no demand. What... deal...?

Sist said this dish isn't worth serving because it's so polarizing. 
Seeing her demand this dish be immediately taken away, it looks as if it doesn't taste very good.

Food_ChefNote_Sist_Like10: Sist wondered whether she could sell it by passing it off as placer gold, but was disappointed to learn how quickly it melted. Judging by how obediently she finished everything, the flavor must have pleased her.

Sist said she enjoys this dish from time to time to lift her mood, and that if it were on the menu, it would be great for laundering money.
Let's just ignore her.

Food_ChefNote_Sist_Like5: Sist mentioned she had once smuggled this item. It was well-received and sold here and there... but when? And where?
Food_ChefNote_Sist_Like6: Sist called it an ordinary roll cake, but highly rated it for its design's economic value.
Food_ChefNote_Sist_Like7: Sist asked if humans liked foods made from processed rice. Seems like she has some business planned for the future.
Food_ChefNote_Sist_Like8: Sist prefers money over snacks, but she took the gift by saying any gift is good. I hope she doesn't resell it...
Food_ChefNote_Sist_Like9: Sist, who usually ponders how to sell things, said she couldn't sell this one and hugged the candy close. She must be really satisfied.
